below_inference_explanation.reading: FL-305 is a DIFFERENT planner's trajectory over the same world -- an inference proxy, not a counterfactual: a world FL-305 happened to land can still miss its burn under the guidance this flight implies (lost-landing classes above; part of the gap is the E7-04-era physics the grid was recorded under, see era_validity), and vice versa. The measurement replaces the inference wherever they disagree; per-row agreement is reported, not assumed.
